## Audit Report

**Objective**: Fix LOW finding — `~/.dracon/sync-notify/dracon-sync-watchdog.sh:20-21` falsely claimed `release.sh` touches `dracon-sync.maintenance-hold` around a binary swap, while no script anywhere references the marker, so an operator stopping the daemon expecting the release script to hold gets it restarted mid-swap ~2.5 min later.

**Verdict on substance**: The false claim is genuinely corrected, not papered over. Pre-fix state confirmed (`HEAD~1` lines 20-21 contain the exact false statement). Post-fix, the comment block (with CORRECTED 2026-08-10 provenance) states explicitly that no script touches the marker, that it is a MANUAL escape hatch, and that operators MUST `touch` it BEFORE stopping the daemon and remove it AFTERWARDS — directly fixing the operator-safety hazard the finding describes. The premise is independently re-verified: a tree-wide grep (excluding orchestrator logs) finds the marker referenced only by the watchdog itself (comment + `HOLD=` var) and the timer comment — no writer script exists. A code change to release.sh was not warranted: its steps are bump/changelog/notes/publish/fixture-check/tag-push with no binary swap and no marker reference, so a comment-only correction is the truthful fix. `bash -n` passes; the watchdog's behavior (HOLD check → skip restart) is unchanged, so the fix is risk-free.

**Contract items**: both satisfied with direct evidence — commit `68144894a` is HEAD on `main` of the `~/.dracon` repo, authored/committed by DraconDev <dracsharp@gmail.com> matching the repo's configured identity, working tree clean, 1 file +10/-2 comment-only; findings.md line 38 is checked with "— fixed in 68144894a (~/.dracon repo)".
